npcs.name: Farmer Geld
npcs.talk_text: Those wolves will be the end of me, friend.

npcs.name: Scout Mira
npcs.talk_text: The wolves come from the northern treeline.

npcs.name: Smith Dorrun
npcs.talk_text: Gear breaks in this world, friend. Bring me the makings and I'll teach you to mend it.

npcs.name: Master-at-Arms Kessa
npcs.talk_text: Show me you can swing that thing. The dummies won't hit back... much.

npcs.name: Ranger Sylas
npcs.talk_text: Something's been stalking the Vale. Deal with it before it deals with you.

npcs.name: Alchemist Vell
npcs.talk_text: Bloodthorn, fresh from the bog's edge. Mind the thorns — and what lives in the mud.

npcs.name: Courier Bram
npcs.talk_text: A bag for the Borderlands outpost. Dangerous run. You flagged for it?

npcs.name: Outpost Sentry
npcs.talk_text: Rival colors out here. You're either brave or lost. Hand it over.

npcs.name: Regent's Courier Edric
npcs.talk_text: The Regent needs a clear road and a reliable messenger. Prove both.

npcs.name: Drillmaster Hale
npcs.talk_text: New blood? Training ring, dummy, token. Move, strike, loot. Go.

npcs.name: Arcanist Loreth
npcs.talk_text: Magic rewards the disciplined mind. Show me your talents.

npcs.name: Cleric Ansa
npcs.talk_text: The Light shapes those who shape themselves. Let us review your path.

npcs.name: Father Osric
npcs.talk_text: Rest a moment, traveler. The Light keeps this house, and its door is never barred. I've read the burial registers three times now, and the counts don't add up across the centuries — more went down into that vault than ever came back up in the record. Something is reaching forward through the graves, and I fear we only sealed it, never ended it.

npcs.name: Warmaster Thane Bralt
npcs.talk_text: Highkeep's Barracks train the realm's finest blades. Show me your steel.

npcs.name: Archmage Sylvaine
npcs.talk_text: The Arcanum welcomes a disciplined mind. Let us refine your talents.

npcs.name: High Priestess Elwyn
npcs.talk_text: Under the Cathedral of Dawn, the Light is taught to those who would wield it.

npcs.name: Master Smith Gorran
npcs.talk_text: Smithing's a proper trade. When the guild opens, I'll take apprentices — soon.

npcs.name: Tailor Mireille
npcs.talk_text: Fine cloth and finer enchantments. Tailoring lessons are coming to the Arcanum.

npcs.name: Alchemist Perrin
npcs.talk_text: Reagents and reactions. The alchemy bench will open to students before long.

npcs.name: Physician Alda
npcs.talk_text: A steady hand saves lives. First aid will be taught here at the Cathedral soon.

npcs.name: Cook Berta
npcs.talk_text: A warm meal mends more than potions. Cooking classes start once the hearth's lit.

npcs.name: Banker Coyne
npcs.talk_text: Welcome to the Bank of Highkeep. Your coin is safe behind three feet of ashlar and one very heavy door.

npcs.name: Merchant Tolley
npcs.talk_text: Torches, rope, rations, trail bread — everything an adventurer forgets to pack.

npcs.name: Weaponsmith Brannick
npcs.talk_text: Blades, hafts, and bowstaves, all keen-edged. Browse the rack once the coffers open.

npcs.name: Innkeeper Doran
npcs.talk_text: Rest your boots at the Gilded Gryphon. Set your hearth here when the beds are ready.

npcs.name: Gryphon Master Kest
npcs.talk_text: My gryphons fly the realm's skyways. Routes open when the roosts are stocked.

npcs.name: Lord Regent Aldous
npcs.talk_text: Welcome to Highkeep, traveler. The realm holds — for now — and it needs able hands.

npcs.name: Highkeep Guard
npcs.talk_text: Keep the peace inside these walls and we'll have no trouble.

npcs.name: Highkeep Guard
npcs.talk_text: The gate stands open to honest folk. Move along.

npcs.name: Lord Castellan Berenger
npcs.talk_text: You stand in Highkeep's great hall, traveler. Mind the runner, bow at the dais, and speak plainly — the Regent's court hears all petitions before sundown.

npcs.name: Steward Maud
npcs.talk_text: Mind the hearths and the lord's table. If you seek coin or trade, the market square is out the gate and up the high street.

npcs.name: Bank Guard
npcs.talk_text: Mind the grille and keep your hands where the tellers can see them.

npcs.name: Auctioneer Hollis
npcs.talk_text: Lots close at dusk! Speak up or lose the lot.

npcs.name: Clerk Petra
npcs.talk_text: Listings, ledgers, and lot numbers — all in order, all in ink.

npcs.name: Warden Skell
npcs.talk_text: Eyes open, steps light. The wild teaches those who listen.

npcs.name: Archprelate Corvin
npcs.talk_text: The Light keeps this city as the walls do — stone without, grace within.

npcs.name: Pip
npcs.talk_text: Bet you can't roll the hoop past the well without it tipping!

npcs.name: Nell
npcs.talk_text: Mama hung the washing, so we get the green till supper.

npcs.name: Tam
npcs.talk_text: We're playing knights and wolves. You can be the wolf!

npcs.name: Town Crier
npcs.talk_text: Hear ye! Lots close at the auction house come dusk!

npcs.name: Goodwife Ida
npcs.talk_text: Fresh loaves 'til the cross casts no shadow.

npcs.name: Peddler Rouse
npcs.talk_text: Ribbons, needles, luck charms — a copper apiece.

npcs.name: Widow Maren
npcs.talk_text: My hearth's the warmest on the lane.

npcs.name: Old Cobb
npcs.talk_text: These stones were mud when I was a boy.

npcs.name: Lamplighter Tosh
npcs.talk_text: Wicks trimmed, lamps lit by dusk.

npcs.name: Gate Watch
npcs.talk_text: Keep the gate lane clear.

npcs.name: Gate Watch
npcs.talk_text: Peace-bind your blades inside the walls.

npcs.name: Wall Watch
npcs.talk_text: West wall is quiet.

npcs.name: Wall Watch
npcs.talk_text: East wall is quiet.

npcs.name: Wall Watch
npcs.talk_text: No trouble along the south curtain.

npcs.name: Wall Watch
npcs.talk_text: The southeast tower is secure.

npcs.name: Keep Guard
npcs.talk_text: The keep is under the Regent's peace.

npcs.name: Keep Guard
npcs.talk_text: State your business before approaching.

npcs.name: Market Watch
npcs.talk_text: Mind your purse in the crowd.

npcs.name: Close Watch
npcs.talk_text: Keep your voice low in the cathedral close.

npcs.name: Throne Guard
npcs.talk_text: Halt at the runner's edge. None approach the dais bearing arms.

npcs.name: Throne Guard
npcs.talk_text: The Castellan receives petitioners. Keep the aisle clear.

npcs.name: Highkeep Bounty Board
npcs.talk_text: Wanted: named beasts too fierce for a lone blade. Muster a party and claim the bounty.

npcs.name: Village Bounty Board
npcs.talk_text: The huntsmaster's postings — elite quarry roaming the outlands. Bring friends.

npcs.name: Pip the Lookout
npcs.talk_text: Blimey — you came out of the OLD stone, not the door. You one of the seance crowd, then? No? Well you're stood in it now, guv. Ashmoor. Gas lamps, motorcars, and the Syndicate owns every cobble the coppers don't. That rift you walked — it never shut. A hundred years it's been leakin', and the folk what run this town learned to LISTEN to it. Keep your head down and your coat closed; that old cut screams you're not from now.

npcs.name: Desk Sergeant Coyle
npcs.talk_text: State your business. — The Syndicate? You're either brave or fresh off the boat, and you don't look wet. Half this house draws two wages, friend, so I'll deny I said a word: thin their crew and the bounty's honest coin. When you've bled them proper, the trail runs to the Grey Gull — an unmarked door off the High Street where their boss holds court. That's where the street ends and the real rot begins.

npcs.name: Roostkeeper Nessa
npcs.talk_text: You've found Elmsvale's roost. Once another roost knows your name, Nessa's gryphons can carry you there for coin.

npcs.name: Sky-Dock Warden Vale
npcs.talk_text: The old sky lanes still answer a brave rider. Register this dock and I can put you aboard for the return west.

npcs.name: Roostwarden Dral
npcs.talk_text: The deep folk keep a gryphon roost above the gate — stone-steady birds, bred for the crags. Register here and the skyways of the Wold are yours.

npcs.name: Transit Warden Okoye
npcs.talk_text: Skyport's still running, if you know the codes. Log your beacon and the lanes back through the rift-echo open up.
